paragraphs.context: The Harbor Bridge opened in 1932. It was designed by the engineer Lena Varga and carries eight traffic lanes.
Tolls on the Harbor Bridge were abolished in 1988 after a public campaign. Cyclists use a separate deck.

qas.question: When were tolls on the Harbor Bridge abolished?
When were tolls on the Harbor Bridge first introduced?
